protocol.name: test_detail_mix_kvasir_v1
protocol.purpose: Evaluation only. Final Test/OOD assessment of the twelve accepted formal_detail_mix_kvasir_v1 checkpoints (4 arms x 3 seeds, epoch 100). No training, no checkpoint selection, no threshold or prompt tuning.
protocol.prompt: a polyp in a colonoscopy image
protocol.small_target_definition: positive image with original foreground fraction <= Kvasir Train positive 25th percentile

val_reproduction_check.description: Before any Test cohort of a run is touched, its source Val evaluation is repeated on the local GPU and compared with the accepted server result. This validates checkpoint loading and the evaluation pipeline on this machine.

protocol.saved_outputs: lossless PNG mask; float16 MC mean and variance (metrics use float32 mean before saving)

gate.description: Fixed before any Test/OOD result of these checkpoints was computed.
gate.statistic: three-seed mean of paired differences, percentage points
gate.pass_rule: g1 and g2 and g3 and guard

secondary_reported_not_gating: image-level sign-flip permutation and Wilcoxon tests on seed-averaged paired differences
bootstrap 95% interval over images, conditional on the three seeds
per-seed sign consistency, gain concentration, precision/recall, FP/FN pixels, failure counts
unique-image sensitivity (ColonDB and CVC300 contain duplicate and shared images)
all other contrasts, including global_mix and the combination
disclosures: The five test sets were already used with earlier attribute-prompt models; they are not untouched holdouts.
ColonDB and CVC300 share 52 exact image hashes and are not independent cohorts.
Evaluation hardware (local RTX 5060 Ti) differs from training hardware (RTX 4090/5090).
Arms for seeds 667/668 were trained on different GPUs (B/G/D on 4090, combination on 5090).
